events.title: Better protected for your next credit application
events.summary: With the entry into force of a new EU law on consumer credit on 20 November 2026, our level of protection when signing up for a credit agreement increases. Designed to strengthen our rights and help us make informed choices, the EU law now covers loans up to €100,000.

events.title: EU backs global compact to cut energy bills and emissions from buildings
events.summary: Today, the European Union has endorsed the Antalya Compact for Energy Efficient Buildings, an initiative to reduce buildings’ energy intensity - energy consumed per m² - by at least 25% by 2035.

events.title: Strategic Orientations 2027–2029 strengthen the radicalisation prevention
events.summary: On 20 November, the Steering Board on Prevention of Radicalisation endorsed the Strategic Orientations for 2027–2029. Aligned with the ProtectEU Agenda, the Strategic Orientations set a common framework to address evolving terrorist and extremist threats.

events.title: Gas Coordination Group confirms EU’s winter preparedness, importance of gas storage through the winter
events.summary: Despite challenging price conditions and continued geopolitical uncertainty, experts from the EU countries, the Commission and stakeholder associations confirmed once again today in the latest meeting of the Gas Coordination Group that the EU is prepared for winter.

events.title: Fifth EU-Armenia Horizon Europe Joint Research and Innovation Committee meeting
events.summary: The meeting reaffirmed Armenia’s efforts and progress in further integrating into the European Research Area (ERA). Both sides acknowledged that Armenia’s participation in Horizon Europe is pivotal to enhance competitiveness and national capacities in research and innovation.

events.title: EU and UK agree to link Emission Trading Systems (ETS)
events.summary: The conclusion of negotiations for an agreement to link the EU’s and UK’s respective Emission Trading Systems (ETS) announced on 20 November at the EU-UK summit paves the ground for a possible future mutual exemption from the partners’ respective Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanisms.

events.title: European innovation in biometrics workshop
events.summary: the European Association for Biometrics and the European Commission cohosted a workshop titled ‘Biometrics Under Pressure: Reliable Identity in Complex Operational Environments’. Participants from nearly 20 countries attended the event, where 10 EU-funded technologies and innovations were presented.

events.title: Commission welcomes political agreement to simplify transparency rules for sustainable financial products
events.summary: The European Commission welcomes yesterday's political agreement by the European Parliament and the Council on the revision of the Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation (SFDR).

events.title: Commission disburses €7.9 billion to strengthen Ukraine's financial stability and advance reform efforts
events.summary: Today, the European Commission has released €7.9 billion to Ukraine to support financing needs and maintain the functioning of the country's public administration, as it continues to defend itself against Russia's war of aggression.

events.title: EU Customs Authority holds first management board meeting in Lille
events.summary: The European Union Customs Authority (EUCA) held its first management board meeting yesterday in Lille, marking a key milestone in the establishment of the new authority to support the EU's new and modernised Customs Union.

events.title: EU bans plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries from November 21
events.summary: The restrictions will apply until at least 21 May 2029, after which those nations may apply to receive plastic waste from the EU.

events.title: EU and Montenegro close accession negotiations on taxation and regional policy
events.summary: Today, the EU and Montenegro provisionally closed accession negotiations on taxation (chapter 16) and regional policy and coordination of structural instruments (chapter 22).

events.title: Ljubljana and Calvià named  2027 European Capitals of Tourism
events.summary: The Commission has named Ljubljiana and Calvià as the winners of the 2027 European Capitals of Tourism competitions, recognising their achievements in advancing smart and sustainable tourism.

events.title: Statement after Commissioner Hansen’s high-level business mission to Mexico
events.summary: The EU and Mexico reaffirm their commitment to strengthening their strategic agri-food partnership and translating the modernised bilateral framework into concrete benefits.

events.title: Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors
events.summary: In this interim final rule (IFR), the Department of Commerce is establishing new rules to prevent certain foreign actors from leveraging advanced computing power based on U.S. technology to threaten U.S. national security and foreign policy interests. First, this rule establishes new restrictions which will apply for exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) to overseas data centers that remotely supply significant volumes of compute to companies headquartered in Country Group D:5 or Macau.
